name: overview
title: OpenVela extends the NuttX foundation
caption: A representative framework call path. These are software responsibilities, not three processes.

name: languages
title: Different languages can use the same C device ABI
caption: C and configured C++ applications can call the C device interface; the ABI does not select a new execution model.

name: apis
title: Familiar file calls; a NuttX-specific device contract
caption: The LED example separates the file operation from the device-specific meaning of the request.

name: execution
title: Defer acquisition; let the application run separately
caption: Orange arrows request later execution. The upper-half readiness notification does not run the application or carry the sample.

name: memory
title: Three build choices, not three runtime layers
caption: Flat builds share memory; protected builds separate kernel and user privilege; kernel builds can provide distinct user address environments.

name: data-flow
title: Retained samples and reader wakeups are different
caption: Teal arrows copy records. The orange notification changes readiness; it does not contain a sample. The second reader has independent progress.

name: sensor-data
title: Sample time, read-out time and arrival time differ
caption: A FIFO read may return several samples. One interrupt, bus transaction, record and application dispatch are not necessarily one-to-one.

name: lifecycle
title: Device startup and safe shutdown
caption: Startup combines build choices and runtime actions. Safe shutdown must stop new production and finish in-flight use before reclaiming state.

name: debugging
title: Correlate execution traces with the data path
caption: OS events show who ran; data timestamps and sequence counters show what happened to a measurement. Correlating both exposes delays and gaps.

name: nxrs-lessons
title: Reuse drivers; make the product boundary explicit
caption: Reuse NuttX below the provider. Normalize device data in the provider; keep product calibration and fusion in the state-owning service.
